alerts.title: Komani: Very high thunderstorm risk within 2 hours
alerts.body: Very high thunderstorm risk over Komani from about 15:38 (forecast estimate). If you hear thunder, go indoors and stay away from floodwater. Follow SA Weather Service warnings.
